title: Music City Retreat: Perfect Base 1Mile to Broadway
description:
This home is located just next to exciting downtown Nashville and being just a few minutes walking distance to the Farmers Market, Tennessee State Museum, Bicentennial Capitol Mall Park, Sounds Stadium, and Germantown. This is a detached 2 story home with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms with private alley access off street parking and a small yard. Clean and comfortable for all your stays.

The space
3 Bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.  2 Bedrooms upstairs with full bathroom in primary and laundry room upstairs. 1 Bedroom downstairs, full bathroom, kitchen, dining area and living room. Guests must navigate 2 steps from sidewalk in front of house to get on entrance walkway and 5 more steps on the front porch to enter front door. From the rear driveway, guests must navigate 4 steps to enter house. To get to the upstairs bedrooms and laundry guests must navigate steps with a landing.

Guest access
Guests will have access to entire house except for 2 storage (owner's closets) which are locked.  Guests will enter home with a code that will work both the front and side door.
